attributes.name: [GCP Cloud Storage OTel] Object read availability 99.5% rolling 30 days
attributes.description: Tracks Cloud Storage object-read availability as the share of valid ReadObject requests that complete with an OK status, over a rolling 30 days, per GCP project. Requests rejected for caller-attributable reasons (NOT_FOUND, PERMISSION_DENIED, UNAUTHENTICATED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FAILED_PRECONDITION, OUT_OF_RANGE, ALREADY_EXISTS, CANCELLED) are excluded from both the numerator and the denominator, mirroring the Valid Requests definition in the Cloud Storage SLA, so the objective reflects storage-side read reliability rather than benign object-existence probing or client misconfiguration. Every other non-OK status consumes error budget, including transient service faults and rate-limit rejections, so status codes not present today still fail safe. A breach means applications could not read object data they were entitled to read.

params.filter: resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type: "gcs_bucket" and attributes.method: "ReadObject" and not attributes.response_code: ("NOT_FOUND" or "PERMISSION_DENIED" or "UNAUTHENTICATED" or "INVALID_ARGUMENT" or "FAILED_PRECONDITION" or "OUT_OF_RANGE" or "ALREADY_EXISTS" or "CANCELLED")
